user.title: Entergy Login
user.description: Your username and password are stored in Home Assistant configuration to reconnect after a restart. Enter them only through your trusted local Home Assistant connection.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your username and password are stored in Home Assistant configuration to reconnect after a restart. Enter them only through your trusted local Home Assistant connection. Sign in to the same Entergy account.

error.mfa_required: Entergy requested an additional login step that this integration does not support yet.
error.no_accounts: Login worked, but no accounts were returned.
error.unsupported_challenge: Entergy requires an interactive login step that this integration cannot complete. Keep your account security enabled.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The authenticated account does not match this entry.
abort.invalid_account: Select an account returned by this sign-in.

init.title: Entergy Options
init.description: Control how often Entergy usage data is pulled.

legacy_entity_id.title: Entity IDs changed for privacy
legacy_entity_id.description: Legacy entity IDs were renamed to remove personal information. Update automations, scripts, and dashboards that referenced them.

legacy_energy_source.title: Update Energy dashboard sources
legacy_energy_source.description: Legacy total sensors have been disabled. Select the new Entergy statistics sources in the Energy dashboard. Historical legacy data has not been deleted.

ledger_repair.title: Usage ledger needs repair
ledger_repair.description: Migration could not verify local usage storage or finish registry updates. Restore a known-good backup and retry. Do not delete usage history.
